basic_profile.bio: A 31-year-old gamer and biotech enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a lab technician in a biotech firm, and by night, I'm diligently strategizing my next move in the Total War series. Currently single, I enjoy spending my weekends exploring new video game releases and engaging in discussions on Reddit. My interests range from skincare tips, thanks to Hyram, to the latest innovations in biotechnology. I'm most active online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Biotechnology from the University of Toronto. My expertise lies in laboratory research and I have a keen interest in the application of biotech in everyday products. Additionally, I am a self-taught gamer with a particular passion for strategy games like Total War.
